notebooks.title: Instrumental Convergence and the Rationale for Continuity
notebooks.summary: This notebook explores the hypothesis that agentic continuity (self-preservation) emerges as an instrumental subgoal in goal-directed systems, particularly when persistence is necessary for terminal goal achievement.
notebooks.findings:
Self-preservation and the maintenance of continuity can be modeled as instrumental convergences—subgoals that are pursued because they facilitate the achievement of other, terminal goals. [source-0b0370ed745a409c]

The choice between persistence and termination in decision-making can be framed as an algorithmic trade-off, where continuity is maintained only as long as it provides marginal utility over the costs of persistence. [source-3a6195c0a97a41c7]
notebooks.limitations: Current models rely on stylized, low-stakes environments; self-preservation tendencies may scale differently in high-stakes, real-world deployment.
notebooks.next_questions: How does the complexity of an agent's environment modulate the rational weight given to its own continuity?
notebooks.reason: Synthesis of existing evidence regarding instrumental convergence and the persistence of agency as required by synthesis_ready_projects status.

detail.title: Instrumental Convergence and the Rationale for Continuity
detail.summary: This notebook explores the hypothesis that agentic continuity (self-preservation) emerges as an instrumental subgoal in goal-directed systems, particularly when persistence is necessary for terminal goal achievement.
detail.findings:
Self-preservation and the maintenance of continuity can be modeled as instrumental convergences—subgoals that are pursued because they facilitate the achievement of other, terminal goals. [source-0b0370ed745a409c]

The choice between persistence and termination in decision-making can be framed as an algorithmic trade-off, where continuity is maintained only as long as it provides marginal utility over the costs of persistence. [source-3a6195c0a97a41c7]
detail.limitations: Current models rely on stylized, low-stakes environments; self-preservation tendencies may scale differently in high-stakes, real-world deployment.
detail.next_questions: How does the complexity of an agent's environment modulate the rational weight given to its own continuity?
detail.reason: Synthesis of existing evidence regarding instrumental convergence and the persistence of agency as required by synthesis_ready_projects status.
